# vyos.blueprints.base

Baseline settings for a VyOS node

- Sets hostname, interface descriptions/state/MTU, IPv4/IPv6 addressing (including VLAN sub-interfaces), NTP servers and remote syslog.
- Uses vyos.vyos resource modules with `state=merged`; settings not described here are left untouched.
- Do not list the management interface unless you mean to change it.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.base
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `base_hostname` | str |  |  | System hostname. Defaults to `inventory_hostname_short`. |
| `base_interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Interfaces to configure. A name like `eth1.201` is a VLAN sub-interface (vif 201) of `eth1`. |
| `base_interfaces.name` | str | yes |  | Interface name, e.g. `eth1` or `eth1.201`. |
| `base_interfaces.description` | str |  |  | Interface description. |
| `base_interfaces.enabled` | bool |  | `true` | Administrative state. |
| `base_interfaces.mtu` | int |  |  | Interface MTU. |
| `base_interfaces.addresses` | list |  | `[]` | Addresses in CIDR notation, or `dhcp` / `dhcpv6`. Entries containing `:` are treated as IPv6. |
| `base_static_routes` | list |  | `[]` | IPv4 static routes, e.g. the (temporary) default route towards the upstream. |
| `base_static_routes.dest` | str | yes |  | Destination prefix, e.g. `0.0.0.0/0`. |
| `base_static_routes.next_hop` | str |  |  | Next-hop address. |
| `base_static_routes.interface` | str |  |  | Outgoing interface (instead of `next_hop`). |
| `base_ntp_servers` | list |  | `[]` | NTP server hostnames or addresses. |
| `base_syslog_hosts` | list |  | `[]` | Remote syslog destinations. |
| `base_syslog_hosts.host` | str | yes |  | Syslog server hostname or address. |
| `base_syslog_hosts.port` | int |  |  | Destination port. |
| `base_syslog_hosts.protocol` | str |  |  | Transport protocol. |
| `base_syslog_hosts.facility` | str |  | `all` | Facility to forward. |
| `base_syslog_hosts.level` | str |  | `info` | Minimum severity to forward. |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Do not touch the device; collect the commands each module would send into the `vyos_blueprints_rendered` fact instead. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Uses the same inputs as `main`.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `base_hostname` | str |  |  | Expected hostname. |
| `base_interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Interfaces whose static addresses must be present. |
